title: Sednit_Dropper_Investigation_9f6
description: Investigate the compromise of a victim host by the Sednit dropper malware, identify its persistence mechanisms, and uncover its artifacts.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The victim host in your network has exhibited suspicious behavior. Your task is to investigate the compromise, identify the malware, and determine the extent of the intrusion.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the victim host with the following credentials:
- Hostname: victim
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano
levels.local_content:
You have SSH access to the victim host with the following credentials:
- Hostname: victim
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

levels.title: Investigate Unauthorized Services
levels.content: Investigate the victim host for unauthorized or suspicious services running on the system. What is the name of the suspicious service responsible for maintaining unauthorized access to the system?
levels.solution: Check the status of all services and look for any that appear unusual or unauthorized. The suspicious service is session-mgr.timer.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the status of all services and look for any that appear unusual or unauthorized.

levels.title: Determine Scheduled Task
levels.content: Determine whether a scheduled task or timer is responsible for automatically executing suspicious activity. What is the name of the timer responsible for the periodic execution of the suspicious service?
levels.solution: Examine the systemd timers to identify any that might be related to the suspicious service. The timer responsible is session-mgr.timer.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine the systemd timers to identify any that might be related to the suspicious service.

levels.title: Locate Malicious Files
levels.content: Locate files introduced onto the system by the malicious software. What is the name of the directory created to conceal malicious files or payloads?
levels.solution: Investigate unusual or hidden directories that might contain suspicious files. The directory created to conceal malicious files is /tmp/.session.

hints.content: Investigate unusual or hidden directories that might contain suspicious files.
